context.research_question: Can a known-field/known-coil finite-ADC radial TSE reference preserve unscaled complex images and components under the declared work and physical timing limits?
context.target_rationale: Keep complex image/component errors <=1e-6, fresh data residual <=1e-10, magnitude contrast >=0.005 and RF proxy <=200. Compare ADC durations at the same 20-billion work allowance; preserve failures instead of changing image targets or fitting gains.
context.assumptions: Authored B0 and receive sensitivity maps, ideal hard 180-degree CPMG, balanced rectangular gradient moments, point ADC and periodic echo-center EPG amplitudes with analytic free Bloch evolution. Not measured calibration, full finite-RF/coherence simulation, fast NUFFT or scanner/clinical certification.
